name: Gangs
overview: Scripture warns believers against joining or following groups that lead to evil, emphasizing personal integrity over conforming to the crowd, as seen in Exodus 23:2 and Psalms 26:4. Wisdom is found in heeding godly instruction and avoiding the company of the wicked or foolish, highlighted in Proverbs 1:8, 4:14, and 13:20. Even in moments of betrayal, such as Judas leading a hostile multitude (Matthew 26:47), the Bible calls Christians to discernment and faithfulness rather than conformity to ungodly associations.
